title: nothing writes into the shared temp directory except Novis's own temp root

stages.title: every test writes under `target/`, sockets included
stages.summary: Adds a socket helper to `nvs-repo`, moves every site left in `NOT_YET_MOVED` to `nvs_repo::scratch` or the new helper, and fixes the test that leaks a locked folder.

stages.title: the two runners use Novis's own temp root
stages.summary: Lets code without a script context create a private folder under the temp root, makes `nvs lsp-test` and the `.nvst` runner use it, and extends the guard to product code.

checks.name: nvs-repo (a socket path is under target/, and one the platform cannot bind stops with the limit named)
nvs-runtime (a folder made without a context is private and named the way the orphan sweep reads)
nvs-lsp (lsp-test writes its cases under the root it is given, and removes them)
nvs-test (the .nvst runner writes its cases under the root it is given, and removes them)
nvs-repo (no code but capability::temp_root reads the system temp dir, test code and product code alike)
